subject: general
question:
Two chords AB and CD of a circle intersect at a point F outside the circle.

If AF = 12 cm, BF = 4 cm and CF = 16 cm, find the length of CD.
solution:
**Given:**

Two chords AB and CD of a circle intersect at a point F outside the circle.

AF = 12 cm

BF = 4 cm

CF = 16 cm

**Concept used:**

If two chords AB and CD of a circle are cut at a point F outside the circle then,

AF × BF = CF × DF

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/047aca248ad0bc08da7ffd23b2e631f8ca0eb5756795e227e2a2f7c5140fd7d8.png] 

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0a8770dee195a6ad7311aff679bab200f196ddf78b6bb295a4a118bda52c62a3.png] **

Let DF be a cm

So, according to the concept,

AF × BF = CF × DF

⇒ 12 × 4 = 16 × a

⇒ 48 = 16a

⇒ a = 48/16

⇒ a = 3

So, DF = 3

Now,

CD = CF - DF

⇒ CD = 16 - 3

⇒ CD = 13 cm

**∴ The length of CD is 13 cm.**
